title and abstract.summary: The study assessed the effects of climate seasonality on poneromorph ants in the Brazilian Amazon by studying variations in composition, richness, and taxonomic and functional diversity across two dry and rainy seasons in the Tapirapé-Aquiri National Forest.

results.summary: This study measured the collection and observed traits (nesting habits and diet) of 46 species of poneromorph ants. The measurements cover multiple species within the collected sample.
